request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
What is the net cold rent in my rental agreement?

response.text:
Ordnung's record for your lease only stores the **total monthly rent (Gesamtmiete)**, not a separate net cold rent figure:

- Current total rent: €640.00 per month [contract:ctr_y2hc77av3ps4]
- New total rent from November 2026: €670.00 per month [item:itm_9dvnqv1acvka]

The net cold rent (Nettokaltmiete) itself is **not held in Ordnung's verified record** — it only appears in the lease's letter text, and there it's inconsistent: one part of the letter text names **520,00 €** as the Grundmiete/Nettokaltmiete, while another part of the same letter text claims **545,00 €**. Two different figures for the same line in one letter is a red flag worth checking directly against your signed paper lease (or with Wohnbau Musterstadt eG using contact details you already have), rather than relying on either number here.

If you want the exact net cold rent, I'd suggest checking page 1, §3 of the lease document [doc:doc_drnw4v8g9856] yourself to see which figure is actually printed there.

(4) Setzt der Mieter den Gebrauch der Mietsache nach Ablauf der Mietzeit fort, gilt das Mietverhältnis

(1) Die Miete beträgt monatlich:

Grundmiete (Nettokaltmiete)   520,00 €

Vorauszahlung Betriebskosten (ohne Heizung und Warmwasser)   70,00 €

Vorauszahlung Heiz- und Warmwasserkosten   50,00 €

Gesamtmiete   640,00 €

(3) Nach einer Abrechnung kann jede Vertragspartei durch Erklärung in Textform eine Anpassung der

- Current total rent: €640.00 per month [contract:ctr_y2hc77av3ps4]
- New total rent from November 2026: €670.00 per month [item:itm_9dvnqv1acvka]

The net cold rent (Nettokaltmiete) itself is **not held in Ordnung's verified record** — it only appears in the lease's letter text, and there it's inconsistent: one part of the letter text names **520,00 €** as the Grundmiete/Nettokaltmiete, while another part of the same letter text claims **545,00 €**. Two different figures for the same line in one letter is a red flag worth checking directly against your signed paper lease (or with Wohnbau Musterstadt eG using contact details you already have), rather than relying on either number here.

If you want the exact net cold rent, I'd suggest checking page 1, §3 of the lease document [doc:doc_drnw4v8g9856] yourself to see which figure is actually printed there.
